page_title: BurnRate — One Dashboard for AI Model Spend

sources.entry: BurnRate - Local-first AI coding cost analytics. Tracks Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, and Aider. Cost breakdowns, 23 optimization rules, rate limit monitoring, provider comparison, and PDF reports.

summary.name: BurnRate
summary.one_liner: BurnRate is a dashboard for tracking AI model spend, combining provider-reported OpenAI and Anthropic costs in a web view with an optional local CLI for coding-agent cost analysis.
use_cases: Track combined OpenAI and Anthropic API spend in one place
Set a workspace budget and watch daily spend against it
Analyze Claude Code subagent costs in agentic workflows
Monitor Claude, Cursor and Codex rate limit utilization
Find per-project cost hotspots across coding tools
Share aggregate provider spend with a small team workspace
summary.what_it_does: The web dashboard connects OpenAI and Anthropic reporting accounts to show provider-reported usage and cost totals, with budgets and trend views. The optional local CLI parses session data on the user's machine to analyze Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cline and Aider, including per-session, per-project and subagent costs. The page describes 46 optimization rules that suggest savings for local usage, plus explainable provider and model recommendations on paid cloud tiers. Rate limit tracking covers Claude, Cursor and Codex windows. The page says prompts, responses and source code are not requested by the cloud dashboard.
notable: Provider-reported cloud spend for OpenAI and Anthropic, kept separate from local API-equivalent estimates
Optional local CLI keeps raw sessions and code on the machine, with per-subagent cost trees for Claude Code
Shared Team workspace with aggregate-only reporting and owner-managed seat billing
caveats: Web dashboard currently connects only OpenAI and Anthropic; other tools are covered by the local CLI only
Free tier is limited to 3 usage sources (including 1 Relay), 1 workspace budget and 30-day history
Savings figures are estimates, not guaranteed outcomes
Platform list for the CLI beyond a brew install command is not explicitly stated on the page
